svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: AKS application platform on Azure
svg.desc: AKS application platform on Azure. 8 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Application Gateway (HTTPS); Application Gateway to User nodes (HTTP to pod IPs (AGIC)); User nodes to Container Registry (pull images); User nodes to Managed identity (token exchange (Entra ID)); User nodes to Key Vault (read secrets); System nodes to Log Analytics; User nodes to Log Analytics.

text.tspan: Application Gateway in front of AKS, with secrets read through workload identity and logs in Log Analytics
